title: RE: FREE BEST BUY GIFT CARD!!

asr.full_text: Hey, Carry Out John! This is RumpelCQ from the Noobs channel. I just want to say that you guys are doing, you and Zach are doing a great job on your channel. All of the improvements are sweet, and we're really looking forward to, Trinity and I are really looking forward to seeing what you guys are doing in the future. It always brings us back, we're upset when there's not a new video, it makes us so angry. I just can't... Are you watching Carry Out John? Um, well I'm not really watching it I'm just doing a video response to Trinity why? What's going on? Because I can really use that $25 gift card to convince my... Why would you want a $25 gift card Trinity? Because I need it for anime gosh! Like why can't you just go mow lawns for your own money? You don't need other people's stuff to get anime! Go outside and do some some mow some lawns mowing lawns hurts my soul that's why I need that $25 gift card I think Cary, Jón and Zach will probably figure someone better out to give it to the noobs...trinity... seriously but anyway Cary, Jón and Zach we'll talk to you guys later enjoy it peace out keep it real
